hooks.command: sh -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; exe="$root/.cache/bin/jouet"; [ -x "$exe" ] || exit 0; exec "$exe" hook codex session-start'
hooks.commandWindows: $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 0 }; $exe = Join-Path $root '.cache\bin\jouet.cmd'; if (Test-Path $exe) { & $exe hook codex session-start }
